SELECT t1.id, t1.field_name, t1.normal_valid_date, t1.deadline_date, t1.normal_amount, t1.deadline_amount, t1.sort, t1.country_type FROM registration_type t1 WHERE 1 = 1
AND t1.field_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.fieldName},'%')
AND t1.country_type = #{queryParams.countryType}
ORDER BY t1.sort ASC, t1.id DESC
